topic.source_contract: BGS geology, ground-stability and foundation-screening evidence

facts.guard: viewer content is discovery evidence and not a site investigation
mapped geology is not an exact geotechnical profile
susceptibility screening is not proof of active movement
database presence or absence is not a current slope-stability assessment
screening does not specify a foundation solution

scope_guards: GeoIndex is a data-discovery viewer and not a completed desktop study or intrusive investigation.
BGS Geology 50K is generalised mapping and not an exact borehole log or foundation stratum.
GeoSure susceptibility classes are screening evidence and not proof of current or future ground movement.
A landslide database record is not an exact active boundary, and no record is not proof of stability.
Foundation-condition mapping does not select foundation type, depth or cost.
Bedrock, superficial deposits, artificial ground and mass-movement deposits remain distinct layers.
BGS mapping is not HMLR title, planning permission or structural certification.
No score or promotion is written without exact site investigation, laboratory, groundwater, design and planning evidence.
